newsitem.title: USA: Penn Octane revenues jump, Q2 profit seen.
newsitem.headline: Penn Octane revenues jump, Q2 profit seen.

text.p: Penn Octane Corp said Thursday estimated gross revenues for the second quarter, ended January 31, were up sharply over the same period last year and it anticipates reporting a profit for the latest quarter, as well as increasing sales and profits for the remainder of the fiscal year ending July 31.
It said sales increasing to $13.4 million in the second quarter from $6.7 million a year earlier.
Sales volume increased to an estimated 22.6 million gallons from 16.8 million gallons for the second quarter of fiscal 1996, Penn Octane said.

The sales and volumes for the latest quarter represent record levels for the company, it said, explaining the record was due primarily to the first full quarter of operations under the new LPG contract with a major customer, which commenced during October 1996.
Gross revenues for the first half were up 29 percent over the same period last year, increasing to $15.9 million from $12.3 million. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
